IGL to Supply Piped Natural Gas to 22 Northern Railway Facilities

Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) has signed an agreement to supply Piped Natural Gas (PNG) to 22 establishments of Northern Railway located across the Delhi-NCR region. This initiative aims to replace the use of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) and diesel at these facilities with PNG.
